headline: BIL Vyapar Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process – Committee of Creditors Meeting
sum: BIL Vyapar Limited, a FMCG trading entity, has entered the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company intimated the NSE of a scheduled Committee of Creditors meeting as part of the statutory CIRP framework.
detail: BIL Vyapar Limited has been admitted into the CIRP under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company filed a formal intimation with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) regarding the convening of a Committee of Creditors meeting, a mandatory governance step under IBC §21. The CoC comprises all admitted financial and operational creditors and is responsible for approving or rejecting resolution plans and other critical decisions during the insolvency process. The specific date, agenda and outcome of the CoC meeting were not disclosed in the exchange filing; this filing constitutes a procedural notification to shareholders and the market.
